title: London Marathon Spectator Guide
claims: The spectator guide lists Cutty Sark at Mile 6.5, Canada Water at Mile 9, Bermondsey at Mile 11.5, Tower Bridge at Mile 13, Canary Wharf and Heron Quays at Miles 18 and 19, Limehouse at Mile 21, Tower Hill at Mile 23 and Westminster at Mile 26.
The guide warns of queues of up to 90 minutes at Cutty Sark and Limehouse and some other stations.
Westminster station will be exit-only from 07:00 to 19:00.
The guide recommends walking between parts of the route and following marshal instructions.
Five accessible viewing areas are managed by stewards and are barrier-free: Cutty Sark, Canary Wharf, Rainbow Row (Butcher Row), Tower Hill and Victoria Embankment.
The guide says the Meet and Greet Area is about 30 minutes' walk from the Finish Line.
The guide recommends using the Uber Boat by Thames Clippers to hop between Woolwich (Royal Wharf) and Westminster, including Greenwich, Canary Wharf, Rotherhithe, Tower and Embankment.
The guide says phone reception may be patchy in congested areas.

The guide lists quieter areas including Rotherhithe Peninsula at Miles 9 to 11, The Highway at Miles 14 and 22, Westferry at Mile 15, Isle of Dogs at Mile 16, Poplar at Mile 20 and Victoria Embankment at Mile 25.
The guide says road closures will be in place and links to affected routes.
